name: United Concordia Dental
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public unitedconcordia.com pages only (Help Center article 'How do I pay premiums?', Contact Us - Members, the public Log in page); no sign-in, no registration. Employer-group members pay through payroll deduction or their employer; members who receive an invoice can mail a check or money order to P.O. Box 827300, Philadelphia, PA 19182-7300 with the full Member ID, use their bank's bill-pay service (payee United Concordia Dental, account number = Member ID, phone 1-888-320-3316 if the bank asks), pay online in MyDentalBenefits, or pay by phone at 1-800-332-0366. The sign-in form asks for Username and Password with Register, Forgot username? and 'Forgot password or unlock your account?' links. AutoPay/recurring payments, paperless billing, guest pay, fees and grace periods are not described on any public page and keep family defaults (autopay stays unknown). Phone lines: members 1-800-332-0366 (TTY 711), DHMO plans 1-866-357-3304, FEDVIP 1-877-394-8224, UCVision 1-888-789-8233; the login page shows a general line 1-800-633-5430 (not used). Live chat is offered after signing in. Signed-in navigation keeps family labels (synthetic).

help.title: How do I pay premiums?
paragraphs: If you are covered through an employer's group dental plan, your premium is taken out of your paycheck or paid by your employer, so there is nothing for you to pay.

If United Concordia Dental sends you an invoice, you can pay online in MyDentalBenefits, call 1-800-332-0366 to pay by phone, or mail a check or money order to United Concordia Dental, P.O. Box 827300, Philadelphia, PA 19182-7300. Write your complete Member ID on the payment.

Paying through your own bank's bill-pay service? Set up United Concordia Dental as the payee and use your Member ID as the account number. If your bank asks for an address and phone number, use the P.O. Box above and 1-888-320-3316.
steps: Log In to MyDentalBenefits with your username and password.
Choose a bank account or card and the amount.

help.title: Contact United Concordia Dental
paragraphs: Questions about your dental coverage: call 1-800-332-0366 (TTY 711). DHMO plans that require a primary care dentist: 1-866-357-3304. FEDVIP plans: 1-877-394-8224. UCVision plan support: 1-888-789-8233.

You can also log in to MyDentalBenefits to start a live chat, send a question through the online email form, or write to the Dental Customer Service Department, P.O. Box 69420, Harrisburg, PA 17106-9420.
